criteria_verification.notes: KeycloakIdentityProvider implements IdentityProvider with sync currentPrincipal getter backed by _currentPrincipal in-memory cache (lines 41-54)

_performSignIn attempts silent refresh first (lines 76-84), falls through to interactive PKCE S256 flow only on failure. Test 'a valid stored session refreshes silently' confirms no browser launch when silent succeeds
_interactiveSignIn uses _config.redirectUrl and _config.scopes (lines 113-134). KeycloakConfig.scopes frozen to ['openid', 'offline_access']. Custom-scheme redirect handled by flutter_appauth
SignInCancelled (lines 20-27) and SignInFailed (lines 29-38) are distinct exception types. _isCancelError distinguishes platform-level cancel (lines 136-141). Test verifies both outcomes
Single-flight guard via _signInInFlight field (lines 57-72). Test 'second concurrent signIn shares one flow' verifies 1 interactive call despite 3 concurrent signIn()

_scheduleProactiveRefresh schedules Timer 5 minutes before accessTokenExpirationDateTime (lines 198-213). Called after sign-in and after each background refresh. Test verifies proactive refresh with soon-expiring token

signOut increments _generation (line 250). _performBackgroundRefresh captures generation at start (line 216), checks after async ops (lines 239-242), discards if changed. Test 'wins over in-flight refresh' verifies principal stays null

_performBackgroundRefresh wraps token refresh in try-catch (lines 218-236). On exception: _currentPrincipal = null, store cleared (lines 231-234), no propagation. Test verifies degradation without throwing

_currentPrincipal initializes to null (line 48). _performSignIn checks stored session, proceeds to interactive if null/expired (lines 76-84). Tests verify absent/unreadable sessions treated as signed out
Test file implements FakeAppAuth (lines 301-392) and FakeSecureSessionStore (lines 395-428) with in-memory state, no platform channels. All tests hermetic
